description: 2025 GMC Hummer EV Pickup (SUT), 3X trim, 24-module pack. The vehicle every observation in this directory was recorded on.
notes: Chemistry is NCMA, not LFP. Relevant to taper shape and to charge-ceiling advice: 80% daily is correct here and would be wrong for an LFP pack.
EPA 381 mi applies to MY2024 onward. The 2022 Edition 1 was quoted 329 mi and the 2023 3X 355 mi, both GM estimates -- at over 8,500 lb GVWR these trucks were exempt from EPA range labelling.

MODEL YEAR IS 2025 AND THE TRIM IS 3X. The library entry gmc-hummer-sut-24 spans MY2022-2026 because the 24-module variant was sold across all of them; that span is correct for the catalogue and must not be narrowed to this one truck. This file is the authority on which specific vehicle the observations came from.
